source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

rows.label: United States
rows.description: country located primarily in North America
rows.hook: is a huge nation whose capital is Washington, D.C

rows.label: United Kingdom
rows.description: island country in north-west Europe
rows.hook: is home to Big Ben and a long-reigning royal family

rows.label: India
rows.description: country in South Asia
rows.hook: is the homeland of Bollywood and the Taj Mahal

rows.label: China
rows.description: country in East Asia
rows.hook: is home to the Great Wall and giant pandas

rows.label: Canada
rows.description: country in North America
rows.hook: is famous for maple syrup, hockey and the Rocky Mountains

rows.label: Germany
rows.description: country in Central Europe
rows.hook: is known for Oktoberfest, autobahns and its capital Berlin

rows.label: Australia
rows.description: country in Oceania
rows.hook: is known for kangaroos, the Outback and the Sydney Opera House

rows.label: Japan
rows.description: island country in East Asia
rows.hook: is known for sushi, anime and Mount Fuji

rows.label: Brazil
rows.description: country in South America
rows.hook: is famous for Carnival, football and the Amazon rainforest

rows.label: Earth
rows.description: third planet from the Sun in the Solar System
rows.hook: is the only place in the cosmos known to host life

rows.label: Italy
rows.description: country in southern Europe
rows.hook: is shaped like a boot and home to Rome and the Colosseum

rows.label: Switzerland
rows.description: country in Central Europe
rows.hook: is known for chocolate, watches and the Alps

rows.label: Nigeria
rows.description: sovereign state in West Africa
rows.hook: is the most populous nation in Africa, with a film industry called Nollywood

rows.label: Solar System
rows.description: the Sun, its planets and their moons
rows.hook: is the cosmic neighbourhood that our Sun rules over

rows.label: flag of the United States
rows.description: national flag of the United States of America
rows.hook: is nicknamed Old Glory and has red and white stripes

rows.label: Mount Rushmore
rows.description: mountain in South Dakota featuring a sculpture of four US presidents
rows.hook: is a granite monument in the Black Hills honoring four famous leaders

rows.label: South America
rows.description: continent located mainly in the southwestern quadrant of the Earth
rows.hook: is the continent home to the Amazon and the Andes

rows.label: Mars
rows.description: fourth planet from the Solar System, tellurian and orange-red due to iron oxide
rows.hook: is called the Red Planet and is a target for future human explorers

rows.label: Pluto
rows.description: dwarf planet in the Solar System
rows.hook: was demoted from full planet status by astronomers

rows.label: Niagara Falls
rows.description: three waterfalls that straddle the international border between Canada and the United States
rows.hook: is a famous thundering cascade between Ontario and New York

rows.label: Alpha Centauri
rows.description: star system in the southern constellation of Centaurus
rows.hook: is the nearest system to our Sun, about four light-years away

rows.label: flag of China
rows.description: national flag of the People's Republic of China
rows.hook: is red with yellow symbols in one corner

rows.label: Central America
rows.description: subregion of the Americas
rows.hook: is the narrow land bridge joining the two big southern and northern continents of the Western Hemisphere

rows.label: flag of Brazil
rows.description: National flag of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.hook: is green and yellow with a blue globe in the middle

rows.label: Big Dipper
rows.description: pattern of seven bright stars in the constellation Ursa Major
rows.hook: is a ladle-shaped sky pattern that points toward Polaris

rows.label: flag of Chile
rows.description: national flag of the Republic of Chile
rows.hook: has a blue square, a red band and a white band, and flies over the Andes

rows.label: Benelux
rows.description: politico-economic union between Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg
rows.hook: is a regional alliance known for waffles, tulips and a tiny grand duchy

rows.label: flag of Turkey
rows.description: national flag of the Republic of Türkiye

rows.label: Voyager program
rows.description: American scientific program consisting of the probes Voyager 1 and Voyager 2
rows.hook: carried golden records of Earth sounds out beyond the planets

rows.label: Flag of New Zealand
rows.description: national flag of New Zealand
rows.hook: shows the Southern Cross on blue with a Union Jack in the corner

rows.label: Orion's Belt
rows.description: asterism
rows.hook: is a famous row of bright points across the waist of a mythical hunter
